verdict.rationale: Unity explicitly attempted a retroactive Runtime Fee that would have repriced already-shipped games based on install counts, then reversed course after backlash (unity-docs-21, unity-comm-1/2/11), and community reports describe unilateral licensing/cost changes imposed on existing customers (unity-comm-5). This directly contradicts the story's claim of pricing stability with no retroactive repricing. missing for 10: any evidence of a durable, contractually-binding no-retroactive-change policy post-controversy.
